title: fix(app-shell): a validation rule guard the publish refuses holds the Studio autosave (#27644)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgVFfRuMa522AiLcTZSChFrD)_

Fixes #27644

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 数据页的「校验规则」标签保留草稿读回的服务端判定，每条规则的条件带上自己的判定路径（`validations.N.condition`），发布会拒收的条件就挡住自动保存。
- 为什么改：之前判定被丢掉，空值比较这类发布拒收的规则照样显示没问题并自动保存（PUT 200），直到点发布才被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台三个文件；每次自动保存后多一次草稿读取。回滚即还原本 PR，不涉及数据或元数据形状。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 DataPillar 加载和 `doSave` 两处、`ConditionBuilder.tsx` 行模式的 hold 计数、`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` 的 `ruleIndex`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.validationVerdictHold-27644.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`DataPillar`** keeps the object draft read's served `_diagnostics` and the body they judged (`editedItemDiagnostics`, the layered read's verdict and body without a pending draft), drops both on each object load, and re-reads the draft after each save, so the next verdict is the stored body's. A sequence counter keeps a stale re-read from landing over a later load. Both are provided to the Validations tab only, through the existing `DraftVerdictContext` / `DraftVerdictBodyContext`.
- **`ObjectValidationsPanel`** hands each rule's guard its verdict path: `validations.N.GUARD`, where N is the rule's index in the draft's raw `validations` list (the index the lint locates by, since #27643) and GUARD is `condition`, or `when` on a conditional rule. A rule not yet in the draft gets none.
- **`ConditionBuilder`** takes `verdictPath`. In raw mode it forwards it to `CelPredicateField`, whose #27612 `useServerHoldAt` already reports the served error through `onLintChange` while the text on screen is the judged text. In row mode no CEL editor is mounted, so the builder reads the same `useServerHoldAt` itself: it shows the served message under the rows and counts it in `onBlockingIssuesChange`. No second hold mechanism and no client copy of the rule: the server's errors are taken whole, at their exact path, through the #27612 helpers.

The panel's verdict count already rides #27629's per-rule kept verdicts, so the hold also survives leaving the tab, and the held line names the rule.

## Why

A guard the publish refuses (an ordering compare on a nullable field, `record.amount > 100`) read clean in the Validations tab and autosaved until Publish refused it. Measured on this branch before the fix: the stored refused guard round-trips as a ROW, so the raw-editor half alone would not hold the card's own shape (ablation 2 below).

## Tests

- New `DataPillar.validationVerdictHold-27644.test.tsx`, pinned the way `PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdictHold-27482.test.tsx` is: a fake door decides the refusal and serves it in the draft read's `_diagnostics`; the CEL engine is stubbed to pass every guard, so every hold is the served verdict's. (a) stored refused draft: another edit to the rule is held, no PUT, the message stays; (b) the card flow: the refused guard saves once, its re-read holds the next edit; (c) editing the guard away releases, the save goes out and its clean re-read clears the message; (d) typed back to the judged text before the autosave fires: held again; (e) leaving the tab keeps the hold; control: the rule beside it shows none of it.
- New `ConditionBuilder.serverHold-27644.test.tsx`: the row builder shows and reports the served error, editing the row away reports 0, and without `verdictPath` nothing is read.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not reproduced live.** The pre-fix behaviour (reads "Valid CEL", PUT 200 until Publish) was not reproduced against a running stack; the ablations below are the before-state evidence.
- **An envelope-form guard is not held.** `serverHoldAt` compares the judged body's value at the path with the text on screen, and a guard stored as an expression envelope (`dialect` + `source`) reads as an object there, so it never matches. No producer of envelope-form validation guards was found (none in `examples/`); the Studio writes a plain string unless the prior value was an envelope. Left as is, not filed.
- **One extra draft read per autosave** in the Data pillar, as the Permission matrix already does after each package-door save.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` hunks: the shared import block (one name added) and `DataPillar` only; disjoint from #27988's `InterfacesPillar` hunks.

## Verification

All readings on this branch, against `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. The final head is `479a7575`: this card's six files over `origin/main` `066ff51e`, which already carries #27988.

- Ablation 1, the served verdict dropped (`DraftVerdictContext.Provider value={objVerdict}` to `value={undefined}`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0): `DataPillar` (a) to (e) fail, the control passes (5 failed, 1 passed). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, the row builder's count dropped (`raw ? celErrors : held.length` to `raw ? celErrors : 0`): both row-builder cases fail, and so do `DataPillar` (a) and (e), the cases that open the stored refused guard (4 failed, 5 passed). This is the measurement that the stored guard opens as a row. Restored the same way.

</details>
